prose.en: Tori lies over uke and holds him down by pressing on uke's upper body. He controls uke's legs from the outside by bringing the heels of his own feet against them.
Image of the entry and of the hold Tori mounts uke's upper body and settles into tate-shiho-gatame. Tori rides on uke's upper body and holds him down while controlling both of uke's legs.
Uke frees the controlled leg and hooks it around tori's leg. Uke frees the leg that is being controlled and entangles tori's leg.
Tori rotates uke to the right and settles onto his upper body. Tori holds uke down while rotating him to the right and controlling his upper body.

heading.en: Faults that are easy to fall into

prose.en: Tori should come up on his toes and bring the heels of both of his own feet in against uke.
Tori should not control uke's legs more than is necessary.
